## The claim

No single route carries the fused result: removing any one admitted ranking route leaves the fused rank-1 pair unchanged.

**Prediction if true.** In the leave-one-route-out table, every single-route removal reproduces the same rank-1 pair as the all-routes fusion.

**What would refute it.** Any single-route removal changes which pair holds fused rank 1.
